name: deviceIdLookup
label: Device ID Lookup
help: Use a documented lookup value such as `gt`.

name: platform
label: Platform
help: Use the platform string expected by Iru, for example `Mac` from the official device list docs.

name: osVersion
label: OS Version
help: Iru's server-side filter: returns versions containing this single string. Use OS Version Contains Any for several strings. All supplied filters are combined.

name: osVersionBelow
label: OS Version Below
help: Returns devices with a numeric OS version strictly below this version, for example 26.7. Compares numeric components, treating missing components as zero. Applied in Make after fetching devices; nonnumeric versions such as 24H2 are excluded. Numeric components can contain up to nine digits.

name: osVersionContainsAny
label: OS Version Contains Any
help: Comma-separated literal strings, for example 26.6., 26.7. Returns devices whose OS version contains at least one string. Applied in Make after fetching devices. If OS Version Below is set, both filters must match.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Maximum number of devices to return across all pages.

name: offset
label: Offset
help: Number of API records to skip before applying the additional OS version filters.
